description: Creep-process setting for blocks. The only keyword 'block creep ?' lists on 3DEC 9.8.54 is momentum-conservation <b>; the engine answers 'Momentum conservation set to true' / 'set to false'. Not on any manual page: what momentum conservation changes in the creep calculation is not documented.

keywords.name: momentum-conservation
keywords.description: Turn momentum conservation on or off for the creep process. The boolean is required ('Missing expected parameter number 4' without it). What the setting changes is not documented.

notes: Listed by 'block ?' on 3DEC 9.8.54; there is no page for it in the 9.8 manual. 3DEC 7.0 has not been probed for it, so no 7.0 block is recorded.
